steps.card: This is Lantern, at HQ. Nothing moves until you start the battle, so take your time and look over the ground.
Pan the view with {camera:forward} and {camera:right}, or rest the pointer at the edge of the screen.
Turn the view with {camera:turn} and tilt it with {camera:pitch}.
Zoom with the mouse wheel: out to see the whole valley, in to see a squad.
The numbered flags are the objectives. Hold them and your score climbs; the first side to the middle of the top bar wins.
Everything you buy arrives by your road in, at the bottom edge. The enemy comes in from the far side.
Your credits are at the bottom, beside Reinforcements. They grow every minute once the battle runs.
Open Reinforcements to see what you can buy.
Choose the scouts, then click the ground where they should go.
Now a rifle squad: hover its card, choose the Bradley it rides in, and place it. One purchase, two units.
The greyed cards along the bottom are orders, not units: they drive in from your road when the battle starts.
Press Start battle when you're ready.
Your units are arriving. Click the scouts, or their card at the bottom, to select them.
Right-click the treeline on the ridge to send the scouts there. Double right-click takes the roads; Shift adds a waypoint.
Right-click and drag to choose which way they face when they arrive: drag toward the village.
Enemies your units can see show their names in red. You see only what your own units see.
A red area is a contact: something was heard or last seen there, not an exact position.
Press {key:contact_focus} to jump the view to your newest contact.
With the scouts selected, press {key:toggle_fire_policy} to hold fire: they shoot only when shot at, and stay hidden.
